status: PROPOSAL, UNWIRED. The owner approved reference spec v1d for development only (OD-NG-6, 2026-10-22); 1M and the extended horizon stay UNAVAILABLE; the 24-bar contract extension is deferred, not cancelled. Any use is PROPOSED-REQUIRES-OWNER-APPROVAL.
formula: p_timeout = (n0 * pi0 + T) / (n0 + K); p_up = p_down = (1 - p_timeout) / 2, computed once; K == 0 returns pi0 exactly
label_rule: r = close[j + horizon_bars] / close[j] - 1; UP if r > band, DOWN if r < -band, else TIMEOUT
population: anchors whose reference_close (UTC epoch seconds) is a multiple of lattice_bars * bar_seconds
counting_rule: K and T count every anchor (single day type) with horizon_end <= reference_close and horizon_end > reference_close - memory_days, and reference_close >= the deployment start when one is given; T counts their TIMEOUT labels
n0_rule: v1's pseudo-count, n0 = 3 days of lattice rows, computed exactly: 3 * 86400 / (lattice_bars * bar_seconds) = 1 row for 1D (v1's integer formula, written for intraday bars, is 0 here)
prior: a single pi0 supplied by the caller from a frozen corpus; never computed here
pending: 1W waits on two definitions the plan does not give: the weekly bar alignment (Binance weeks open on Monday 00:00 UTC, which is not a multiple of 7 days from the epoch) and the phase of its 3-week lattice
provenance: NGA plan v1.0 §F.2 L1 ('spec v1d (1D 365 d single type; 1W all available)'); v2 §F.2 L1; Track A §7 ('single type for 1D+', 'pseudo-count n0 = 3 days of rows')
